APEX / HERITAGEPHOTO AUDIT · 0.16.0-preview.1

Photographs first.
Visible corrections.

Ten circuit views. Five representative car eras. Real photographs beside actual production renders, with a record of what changed — and what the evidence does not establish.

10 circuits reviewed / Spa & Monaco follow-up5 car-era proportions reviewed15 credited source photographsAll images embedded / works offline
TYRE WOBBLE FIXED AT THE AXLESteering and spin previously shared one XYZ Euler transform. Spinning a steered wheel tipped its axle once per revolution. The hierarchy is now chassis → Y-steering hub → X-spinning tyre. The hub stays aligned while the tyre rotates, including AI cars. Wheel spin and support use each actual radius, including smaller 1967 front tyres.

These are bounded, photo-guided corrections, not a full surveyed reconstruction. Source photos span different years. New Spa surfaces apply only to the latest preset; Monaco's modern hotel/tunnel is shared across all eras by request. Older surface presets remain byte-identical, including the previously requested all-era Spa/Monaco exceptions. The 2021 selection continues to use its explicitly labelled recent-surface substitute.

CIRCUIT REVIEW

Spa-Francorchamps

OBSERVED IN PHOTOLa Source/pit straight context and red/yellow Spa kerbs; the supplied image-8 is a game view, not a surveyed photograph.

IMPLEMENTED / RETAINEDLa Source continuous paved escape and paved pit island; separate Les Combes T5/T6 and Malmedy T7 kerbs, green/gravel margins; short right-left Bus Stop apices, green-edged finish straight and grid markings. Follow-up placements also use user-supplied views, which are not redistributed.

STILL UNCERTAINRoad centreline and legal white-line width unchanged; exact pit-island geometry and lettering remain approximate.

CIRCUIT REVIEW

Monaco

OBSERVED IN PHOTOPiscine is constrained harbour-side asphalt with Armco and close quay facilities.

IMPLEMENTED / RETAINEDExisting mapped Piscine/harbour treatment retained. Separate user tunnel reference guides a connected over-road Fairmont hotel mass and portal; overhead geometry keeps the existing 4.65 m tunnel ceiling clear and is shared across all eras.

STILL UNCERTAIN2022 off-session photo does not establish race-day barrier placement; no new barrier offset claimed.

Scope and attribution. Every reference photo retains its own linked Creative Commons license; resized photographic adaptations retain the same terms. Game screenshots are separate original rendered works. Reference photos are not game textures. No verified chassis scans or exact constructor CAD have been added. Sponsor lettering remains authored approximation, not licensed corporate vectors.
Photos and renders are not camera-calibrated or pixel-registered. A photograph from an older year, a restoration or an off-session view is not proof of an exact race configuration. Read the uncertainty note on each card.
